title: Vote to merge the baseline V4 AMT spec PR into the main repo
summary: Amogh Jahagirdar called a vote to merge the baseline V4 adaptive metadata tree spec PR into the main repository. He stressed that, like earlier spec votes, this is a vote to merge the changes and not a vote for adoption. Encryption, specific requirements for column file updates, dropping the partition tuple and other areas can be iterated on later; the aim is to land a baseline that will not need extensive rebasing while other V4 work continues. Replies were all in favor. Gábor Kaszab said he would cover the encryption part in an immediate follow-up change, and Szehon Ho left comments on the PR to clarify harder-to-read parts. Amogh announced that the vote passed and said he would merge the PR.

positions.stance: Merge the baseline V4 AMT spec changes now, as a merge and not an adoption vote, and iterate later on encryption, column file updates and dropping the partition tuple.
Supports the merge and will cover the encryption part with an immediate follow-up change.
The spec looks correct; he left comments to clarify some of the harder-to-read parts.

outcome.note: Passed with 18 +1 votes (9 binding, 9 non-binding) and no 0 or -1 votes. Amogh Jahagirdar said he would merge the baseline spec PR.

why_it_matters: The baseline V4 adaptive metadata tree spec text lands in the main repository, giving other V4 changes a common base, without being adopted yet.
